stories.headline: CHATGPT GETS A *WALLET*
stories.facts: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its Dots AI agents make purchases for US Pro subscribers using supported payment cards.
stories.caption_line: 💳 OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing Dots AI agents to buy items online for eligible US Pro subscribers.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek translucent smartphone displaying a biometric fingerprint scanner in the foreground, with floating credit cards radiating light. In the midground, automated shopping parcels glide along a futuristic warehouse conveyor belt against a nocturnal city skyline. Holographic checkout interface panels, digital security shields, and glowing data streams hover in the air. Dramatic studio lighting with vivid electric-blue and warm-orange illumination across the high-tech scene.
stories.source_title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC *CRUSHES* IPO RECORDS
stories.facts: Anthropic's public offering is six times oversubscribed, putting it on track to become the largest IPO in history.
stories.caption_line: 📈 Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on course to become the biggest stock offering in history.
stories.image_prompt: A monumental glowing financial trading terminal and corporate podium in the foreground. In the midground, a bustling stock exchange trading floor sits beneath towering skyscraper glass facades at twilight. Holographic financial candlestick charts surge upward alongside floating percentage gauges, network data nodes, and market trendlines. High-contrast cinematic lighting with intense electric-blue highlights and warm-orange accents casting dramatic reflections.
stories.source_title: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on track to become the largest public offering in history

stories.headline: RESEARCHER CLAIMS *BANNED* CHIPS
stories.facts: A former OpenAI researcher claims technical analysis detected Nvidia Blackwell signatures in six Chinese AI models, estimating the hardware cost over half a billion dollars.
stories.caption_line: 🔍 A former OpenAI researcher claims technical evidence shows Nvidia Blackwell chips were used across six Chinese AI models.
stories.image_prompt: A giant, intricately detailed silicon microchip glowing with complex circuitry in the foreground. In the midground, towering server racks within a massive dark data center corridor stand beside a digitized world globe showing glowing international transit lines. Holographic forensic scanning grids, floating circuit schematics, and binary code streams surround the processor. Moody cinematic rim lighting in electric-blue with warm-orange fiery glows accentuating the metallic hardware.
stories.source_title: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models

stories.headline: META AI *CALLS* LOCAL BUSINESSES
stories.facts: Meta equipped its Muse assistant with outbound phone capabilities to call businesses for restaurant bookings and customer service.
stories.caption_line: 📞 Meta updated its Muse AI assistant to dial and speak with businesses directly on behalf of users.
stories.image_prompt: A confident portrait of Alexandr Wang in the foreground, standing with arms folded and gazing off-camera. In the midground, a bustling restaurant dining room and a multi-line corporate customer support desk sit under sleek architectural lighting. Holographic soundwaves, glowing telephone dialer interfaces, and interconnected audio network beams float smoothly in the atmosphere. Polished studio lighting with vivid electric-blue ambient fill and warm-orange rim highlights.
stories.source_title: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI

stories.headline: CLAUDE *ENTERS* THE FACTORY
stories.facts: Anthropic launched Claude for Manufacturing, connecting AI directly to industrial software from Autodesk and Oracle to handle supply chains.
stories.caption_line: 🏭 Anthropic debuted Claude for Manufacturing to link AI directly with industrial design and supply chain software.
stories.image_prompt: A heavy-duty industrial robotic arm positioned prominently in the foreground amidst precision machinery. In the midground, a high-tech factory assembly floor stretches out with automated transport carts and towering logistical supply racks. Holographic CAD blueprints, floating mechanical schematics, and inventory management data panels hover over the machinery. Industrial atmosphere with sharp electric-blue task lighting and warm-orange welding spark reflections.
stories.source_title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows

stories.headline: AMAZON *MAPS* GLOBAL SHOPPING
stories.facts: Amazon is building the World Product Graph to index every item sold online, keeping shoppers from leaving its site.
stories.caption_line: 🌐 Amazon is cataloging every product sold across the entire internet in its massive World Product Graph vault.
stories.image_prompt: A massive holographic digital globe enveloped in dense interconnected product catalogs in the foreground. In the midground, an expansive automated fulfillment center operates with endless rows of storage shelving and fast-moving robotic sorting pods. Floating database nodes, glowing shopping cart icons, and web-indexing data vectors sweep across the air. Deep perspective with dramatic electric-blue volumetric lighting paired with warm-orange backlights.
stories.source_title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data

stories.headline: AI *ADVISES* US AIR TRAFFIC
stories.facts: The FAA expanded an AI advisory tool across all US airspace to help manage air traffic congestion.
stories.caption_line: ✈️ The FAA expanded an AI advisory tool across the entire US airspace to help manage air traffic congestion.
stories.image_prompt: A high-tech air traffic control radar console with glowing flight instruments in the foreground. In the midground, commercial jetliners taxi across active airport runways beneath an iconic control tower against a twilight sky. Holographic radar sweeps, three-dimensional flight trajectory paths, and airspace coordinate grids float above the consoles. Dramatic twilight atmosphere illuminated by electric-blue runway guidance lights and warm-orange cockpit instrumentation glows.
stories.source_title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace

cover_subline: OpenAI launches agent wallet, Anthropic IPO surges, and banned chips found.
cover_image_prompt: A dramatic photorealistic collage featuring a glowing biometric smartphone and an illuminated microchip in the foreground, with Alexandr Wang standing in a confident portrait to the side. In the midground, towering stock exchange columns and an industrial robotic factory blend into a futuristic metropolis. Holographic upward-surging market charts, radar vector lines, and radiant data particles fill the space. Vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange cinematic lighting with rich atmosphere.
caption:
From AI agents spending your money to Anthropic's record-breaking IPO, AI moves fast.

1. 💳 OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing Dots AI agents to buy items online for eligible US Pro subscribers.
2. 📈 Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on course to become the biggest stock offering in history.
3. 🔍 A former OpenAI researcher claims technical evidence shows Nvidia Blackwell chips were used across six Chinese AI models.
4. 📞 Meta updated its Muse AI assistant to dial and speak with businesses directly on behalf of users.
5. 🏭 Anthropic debuted Claude for Manufacturing to link AI directly with industrial design and supply chain software.
6. 🌐 Amazon is cataloging every product sold across the entire internet in its massive World Product Graph vault.
7. ✈️ The FAA expanded an AI advisory tool across the entire US airspace to help manage air traffic congestion.
